title: Some Sing Of His Power-who Has That
summary: Control is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?
lifeApplication: Release one demand that peace must wait for total control. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
